paintings.blurb: A huge face of gray granite fills most of this canvas, with a field of snow lying in the bowl below it. Payne painted the rock in broad, flat planes of gray and tan. Dark pines and a strip of blue lake run along the bottom.
paintings.setting: A granite cirque in the Sierra Nevada, where snow lies below the cliffs most of the year.
paintings.alt: A massive gray granite mountain face with a white snowfield below it, dark pines and a blue lake along the bottom.

paintings.file: Mary DeNeale Morgan Lone cypress.jpg
paintings.title: Lone Cypress
paintings.blurb: A single cypress grows from the top of a rock outcrop over the sea, its roots holding to the stone. Morgan painted the rock in pale gold and gray and the water in green and white. A second tree stands at the left, and the coast runs off into haze.
paintings.setting: The rocky shore of the Monterey Peninsula, where a few cypress trees grow on outcrops above the surf.
paintings.alt: A cypress tree growing on top of a pale rocky outcrop above green water and white surf, the coast fading behind.

paintings.file: Glimpse of the Sea, by Franz Bischoff.jpg
paintings.title: Glimpse of the Sea
paintings.blurb: This painting shows how thickly Bischoff could lay on paint once he left porcelain behind. The canyon walls are built of heavy strokes in gold, green and brown. The title names the sea, which shows only as a small pale patch at the top, past the hills.
paintings.setting: A coastal canyon in Southern California, with the ocean just in view past the ridges.
paintings.alt: A brushy canyon painted in thick strokes of gold, green and brown, with a small glimpse of pale sea beyond the hills.

paintings.file: Thomas Hill - Mount Tallac from Lake Tahoe (1880).jpg
paintings.title: Mount Tallac from Lake Tahoe
paintings.blurb: Mount Tallac rises above the southwest shore of Lake Tahoe, and Hill painted it with snow covering its upper slopes. The trees at its foot have turned red and gold, and the lake in front lies still. A blue sky with a few clouds fills the top of the canvas.
paintings.setting: Mount Tallac, a peak on the southwest side of Lake Tahoe known for the snow cross on its face.
paintings.alt: A snow-covered mountain peak above red and gold autumn trees and a calm dark lake, under a blue sky.

paintings.file: Edgar Payne Sierra Peaks.jpg
paintings.title: Sierra Peaks
paintings.blurb: Payne painted these jagged peaks in a strong blue-violet, with snow running down the gullies in white. Pale granite slabs and a few twisted pines fill the foreground. A little blue lake shows at the lower left.
paintings.setting: The jagged crest of the high Sierra Nevada, above the last trees.
paintings.alt: Jagged blue-violet peaks with white snow in the gullies, pale granite slabs and twisted pines in front, a small blue lake at left.

paintings.file: Edgar Payne Sierra Splendor.jpg
paintings.title: Sierra Splendor
paintings.blurb: Payne painted rock in many colors at once, and here the peak is rust, gray, violet and tan. Below it a green meadow and a blue-green lake catch the sun. White clouds sit along the ridge in a deep blue sky.
paintings.setting: A lake and meadow below a high peak in the Sierra Nevada.
paintings.alt: A rust and gray mountain peak above a blue-green lake and bright green meadow, under white clouds and blue sky.

paintings.file: Granville Redmond - Morning on the Pacific.jpg
paintings.title: Morning on the Pacific
paintings.blurb: In this painting the light comes from behind the waves and turns the sea silver and blue. A wave breaks white near the shore, and dark rocks fill the bottom edge. Redmond kept the sky almost as pale as the water.
paintings.setting: The Southern California coast early in the day, looking out over the Pacific.
paintings.alt: Silvery blue sea with a wave breaking white, dark rocks along the bottom edge and a pale, misty sky.

paintings.file: Edgar Payne Sierra Sunset.jpg
paintings.title: Sierra Sunset
paintings.blurb: At sunset the granite of the Sierra can turn red for a few minutes, and Payne caught that moment here. The upper slopes glow red and orange with white snow across them, while the land in front has gone dark. A pale lavender sky sits above.
paintings.setting: The Sierra Nevada at sundown, when the last light colors the high granite.
paintings.alt: Mountain slopes glowing red and orange with snow across them at sunset, the foreground in shadow under a pale lavender sky.

paintings.file: Thomas Hill - Nevada Falls, Yosemite.jpg
paintings.title: Nevada Falls, Yosemite
paintings.museum: White House Art Collection, Washington, D.C.
paintings.blurb: This tall canvas belongs to the White House collection. Nevada Fall pours over a sheer cliff in a white column, and the river below foams down through rocks and pines. Hill painted the cliff in warm browns and the mist in soft white.
paintings.setting: Nevada Fall, on the Merced River above Yosemite Valley, about 594 feet high.
paintings.alt: A waterfall pouring in a white column over a sheer brown cliff, the river foaming down through rocks and pines below.

paintings.file: Santa Barbara Hills by William Keith, 1882.jpg
paintings.title: Santa Barbara Hills
paintings.museum: Fine Arts Museums of San Francisco (de Young)
paintings.blurb: Keith traveled the length of California to paint, and in 1882 he worked around Santa Barbara. A grove of dark oaks stands on a rise at the right, and a meadow stretches out in front. White clouds fill the sky over the hills.
paintings.setting: The hills above Santa Barbara, between the Santa Ynez Mountains and the sea.
paintings.alt: A grove of dark oak trees on a rise beside a broad meadow, with white clouds in a pale blue sky.

paintings.file: Edgar Payne South Rim, Grand Canyon.jpg
paintings.title: South Rim, Grand Canyon
paintings.blurb: Payne traveled through the Southwest for much of his career, and he painted the Grand Canyon in the same strong color he used for Navajo country. A red rock point juts in from the right, its face lit by the sun. Beyond it the layered canyon fades into blue and pink haze.
paintings.setting: The South Rim of the Grand Canyon in Arizona, made a national park in 1919.
paintings.alt: A red rock promontory lit by sun at right, with the layered walls of a huge canyon fading into blue and pink haze beyond.

paintings.file: Mary DeNeale Morgan Monterey Cypress on the Shore.jpg
paintings.title: Monterey Cypress on the Shore
paintings.blurb: This painting has also gone by the title The Cypress of Point Lobos. Morgan painted a whole grove here: tall trunks rising in pairs, dark crowns spread across the sky, and low red and green shrubs among them. The sea shows in blue and white between the trunks.
paintings.setting: Point Lobos, south of Carmel, one of the two places where the Monterey cypress grows wild.
paintings.alt: A grove of tall cypress trees with dark spreading crowns above low shrubs, the blue sea and white surf seen between the trunks.

paintings.file: Colin Campbell Cooper - The Lotus Pool, El Encanto, Santa Barbara - 1922.163.1 - Reading Public Museum.jpg
paintings.title: The Lotus Pool, El Encanto, Santa Barbara
paintings.blurb: Cooper painted this in his first years in Santa Barbara, where he moved in 1921. A pool covered with lotus leaves and pale blossoms reflects the scene above it. Brick pillars hung with vines stand behind the water, and tall eucalyptus trees rise against a pale sky.
paintings.setting: El Encanto, a hotel and garden built on the hills above Santa Barbara.
paintings.alt: A pool full of lotus leaves and pale flowers reflecting vine-covered brick pillars and tall eucalyptus trees behind.

paintings.file: Edgar Payne Summit Lake, High Sierras.jpg
paintings.title: Summit Lake, High Sierras
paintings.blurb: The peaks in this painting are purple and gray with snow on their ledges, and a dark lake lies at their feet. Pale granite slabs and dark pines fill the foreground. Payne often painted such lakes from the shore where his camp stood.
paintings.setting: A lake near the crest of the Sierra Nevada, ringed by granite and pine.
paintings.alt: Purple-gray peaks with snow on their ledges above a dark lake, with pale granite slabs and dark pines in front.

paintings.file: Guy Rose - The sea view of cliffs.jpg
paintings.title: The Sea View of Cliffs
paintings.blurb: Rose painted the surf with fast, loose strokes. In this painting a wave throws white spray high against dark rocks at the left. The water behind runs from green near the rocks to deep blue at the horizon.
paintings.setting: The rocky coast of California, where Rose painted from Laguna to Carmel.
paintings.alt: White spray from a breaking wave flying up against dark rocks, green and deep blue water out to the horizon.

paintings.file: Frank Cuprien - 9fe4ae6940.jpg
paintings.title: The Majesty of Laguna Beach
paintings.blurb: This wide, narrow picture is painted on illustration board, a material Cuprien used often for quicker work. He stood high on a bluff and looked down the coast, so the green slopes, the long beach and the white surf all run toward the far point. A low gray sky covers the scene.
paintings.setting: The bluffs and beaches of Laguna Beach before the town filled in, seen from high above the shore.
paintings.alt: A wide view from a green bluff down a long sandy beach with white surf, the coastline fading under a low gray sky.

paintings.file: William Wendt - 'Wash Day'.jpg
paintings.title: Wash Day
paintings.blurb: Wendt painted farm buildings often, but seldom the people who lived in them. In this canvas tall eucalyptus trunks stand in front of a weathered wooden house and barn. Laundry hangs out to dry, and green hills rise behind under a pale sky.
paintings.setting: A small farm in the hills of Southern California.
paintings.alt: Tall eucalyptus trunks in front of a weathered wooden house and barn, laundry hanging out and green hills behind.

paintings.file: Scene in Russian River Valley, Sonoma, California by William Keith.jpg
paintings.title: Scene in Russian River Valley, Sonoma, California
paintings.blurb: This small canvas comes from Keith's years of travel around Northern California, and riders appear in it. They follow a trail through brush and trees toward a valley. The far hills are soft under a sky of gray and white clouds.
paintings.setting: The Russian River valley in Sonoma County, north of San Francisco.
paintings.alt: Riders on a trail through brush and trees leading toward a valley, soft hills under gray and white clouds.

paintings.file: Edgar Payne Sunset on the Foothills of Pasadena.jpg
paintings.title: Sunset on the Foothills of Pasadena
paintings.blurb: Payne painted the mountains above Pasadena many times, in every light. Here the last light turns the slopes pink and orange, with a touch of pink cloud in the sky. Bare trees and dark brush stand in the shadowed field below.
paintings.setting: The San Gabriel Mountains above Pasadena at sundown.
paintings.alt: A large mountain glowing pink and orange at sunset, bare trees and dark brush in the shaded field below.

paintings.file: Jack Wilkinson Smith - 59646b695e.jpg
paintings.title: California Coast
paintings.blurb: Smith's seascapes are some of his strongest work, and he painted the surf with real force. In this large canvas the sea pours through a channel between dark rocks, breaking into white foam. A pale gray sky leaves all the attention on the water and stone.
paintings.setting: A rocky stretch of the California coast where waves funnel between the rocks at high tide.
paintings.alt: White surf rushing through a channel between dark brown rocks, under a pale gray sky.

paintings.file: Edgar Payne Surging Sea.jpg
paintings.title: Surging Sea
paintings.blurb: Payne's sea paintings are as heavy with paint as his mountain ones. Here a wave breaks white against brown rocks at the left, and the water behind it heaves in green and gray swells. A rocky headland lies along the top under a pale, smoky sky.
paintings.setting: A rocky shore on the Southern California coast during a winter swell.
paintings.alt: A wave breaking white against brown rocks, green-gray swells in the water, and a rocky headland under a pale sky.

paintings.file: Edgar Payne Sycamore in Autumn, Orange County Park.jpg
paintings.title: Sycamore in Autumn, Orange County Park
paintings.blurb: A huge sycamore fills this canvas, its trunk splitting into wide limbs and its leaves turned yellow. Sunlight comes through the crown and lights the grass beneath in bright green. Payne painted the leaves with quick dabs of yellow and gold and let a little blue sky show through.
paintings.setting: Orange County Park, opened in 1897 and now Irvine Regional Park, known for its old oaks and sycamores.
paintings.alt: A huge sycamore tree with a thick, spreading trunk and yellow autumn leaves, sunlight on the green grass below.

paintings.file: Mrs. Bischoff Wisteria, by Franz Bischoff.jpg
paintings.title: Mrs. Bischoff (Wisteria)
paintings.blurb: Bischoff rarely painted people, and this is one of the few. His wife stands on a wooden ladder in a long pink dress, reaching up into a pergola heavy with purple wisteria. He used the same care for the flowers that he had used for decades painting roses on china.
paintings.setting: A garden in South Pasadena, near the house and studio Bischoff built by the Arroyo Seco.
paintings.alt: A woman in a long pink dress stands on a ladder, reaching into a wooden pergola hung with purple wisteria blossoms.

paintings.file: Thomas Hill - Royal Arches and Domes of Yosemite.jpg
paintings.title: Royal Arches and Domes of Yosemite
paintings.blurb: Hill painted this view from the river in soft, even light. The Royal Arches rise on the left, with Half Dome in haze at the center. A rider fords the Merced River in the middle distance, and trees line both banks.
paintings.setting: The Merced River in the east end of Yosemite Valley, below the Royal Arches and Half Dome.
paintings.alt: A pale granite wall with curved arches at left and Half Dome in haze, a rider crossing a calm river lined with trees.

paintings.file: Spring Landscape (Spring in Marin County) by William Keith.JPG
paintings.title: Spring Landscape (Spring in Marin County)
paintings.museum: Fine Arts Museums of San Francisco (de Young)
paintings.blurb: This painting comes from Keith's middle years, after his style had softened. A green meadow with a small stream runs back to hills, some of them in sun and some in shadow. Sheep graze in the field, and big clouds move across the sky.
paintings.setting: The hills of Marin County, north of the Golden Gate, green after winter rain.
paintings.alt: A green meadow with a small stream and grazing sheep, sunlit and shadowed hills beyond under large clouds.

paintings.file: Guy Rose - View in the San Gabriel mountains.jpg
paintings.title: View in the San Gabriel Mountains
paintings.blurb: Rose painted this tall canvas from a slope looking up a canyon. Green and gold chaparral fills the foreground, and the far ridges are painted in pale blue and violet. The mountains seem to fade into light as they go back.
paintings.setting: The San Gabriel Mountains above the valley where Rose was born.
paintings.alt: A canyon in the mountains with green and gold brush in front and pale blue and violet ridges fading into the distance.

paintings.file: Edgar Payne Temple Crag, High Sierra Lake.jpg
paintings.title: Temple Crag, High Sierra Lake
paintings.blurb: Temple Crag is a steep, fluted wall of granite above the Big Pine Lakes, and Payne painted it many times. Here its red-gray towers rise above a dark lake, with snow in the couloirs between them. A cluster of dark pines stands on the shore at the left.
paintings.setting: Temple Crag, a 12,999-foot peak beside the Palisades on the east side of the Sierra Nevada.
paintings.alt: Steep red-gray rock towers with snow in the gullies between them, above a dark lake with pines on the shore.

paintings.file: Carl Oscar Borg Watching the Race.jpg
paintings.title: Watching the Race
paintings.blurb: Horses appear in much of Borg's work from the Navajo country. In this painting three riders pause on a rise and look out over a wide valley toward the event the title names. Borg painted them from behind, so the viewer looks where they look, across sage and dust toward pale hills.
paintings.setting: A ridge above a broad valley on the Navajo lands of northern Arizona.
paintings.alt: Three Native riders on brown horses pause on a scrubby ridge, looking out over a wide hazy valley toward distant hills.

paintings.file: Edgar Payne The Purple Vale.jpg
paintings.title: The Purple Vale
paintings.blurb: This painting is softer than most of Payne's work. The mountains are a pale blue-violet, and a light mist fills the valley in front of them. A single large oak stands on the right in dark green, and a few smaller trees grow along the slope below.
paintings.setting: A valley in the hills of Southern California on a hazy morning.
paintings.alt: Pale blue-violet mountains above a misty valley, a large dark green oak tree on the right and smaller trees below.

paintings.file: Edgar Payne The Rendezvous, Santa Cruz Island.jpg
paintings.title: The Rendezvous, Santa Cruz Island
paintings.blurb: Santa Cruz Island's coast is cut with sea caves and arches, and Payne painted one here from the water. A great arch of orange rock opens over green water, its inside in shadow. A few small figures stand on the pale beach at the back of the cave.
paintings.setting: The coast of Santa Cruz Island, which has some of the largest sea caves in the world.
paintings.alt: A huge arch of orange rock opening over green water, with a few small figures on a pale beach inside the cave.

paintings.file: Stream Through the Valley by William Keith, 1901.jpg
paintings.title: Stream through the Valley
paintings.blurb: A big oak leans over a shallow creek that runs among stones, its leaves bright green in the sun. Dry gold grass covers the banks, and a green hill rises at the left under a clear sky. Keith painted this in brighter light than most of his late work.
paintings.setting: A creek in the oak country of Northern California in summer.
paintings.alt: A large oak leaning over a shallow, stony creek, dry gold grass on the banks and a green hill under a clear sky.

paintings.file: Mary DeNeale Morgan Old Monterey.jpg
paintings.title: Old Monterey
paintings.blurb: Morgan painted this just before she moved to Carmel for good, when Monterey still had many of its old adobe houses from the Mexican era. A woman in a black shawl walks with a small child along a sunny lane. Beside them stands a whitewashed house with green shutters and red flowers, under dark cypress trees.
paintings.setting: Monterey, the capital of Alta California under Spain and Mexico, known for its adobe houses.
paintings.alt: A woman in a long black shawl walks with a small child down a sunny lane past a white house with green shutters and red flowers.

paintings.file: Edgar Payne The Valley Village.jpg
paintings.title: The Valley Village
paintings.blurb: Payne painted this village on his European trip in the early 1920s. A church steeple and a cluster of houses with red roofs sit in a green valley, a wooden fence in front. Snowy peaks and glaciers fill the sky behind, painted in strong white and blue.
paintings.setting: A village in the Alps, painted during Payne's stay in Europe from 1922 to 1924.
paintings.alt: An alpine village with a church steeple and red-roofed houses in a green valley, below snowy peaks and glaciers.

paintings.file: California Poppies by Benjamin Chambers Brown.jpg
paintings.title: California Poppies
paintings.blurb: Poppy fields made Brown popular with collectors, and he painted them for decades from his home in Pasadena. In this one the orange flowers run along the slope in the foreground, dark oaks stand in the middle distance, and snow still covers the peaks beyond. He placed spring in the valley and winter on the mountains in a single view, the way the San Gabriel foothills often look in March.
paintings.setting: The foothills below the San Gabriel Mountains, where poppies bloom in spring while snow lingers on the high peaks.
paintings.alt: A hillside of orange poppies and green grass, dark oak trees in a valley, and snow-capped mountains under a pale sky.

paintings.file: Mission Valley, by Maurice Braun.jpg
paintings.title: Mission Valley
paintings.blurb: Braun belonged to the Theosophical community at Point Loma, which taught that nature and spirit are one, and that belief shaped how he painted landscape. Here tall eucalyptus trees stand on a grassy slope above a wide valley. He painted the far hills in soft blue and lavender, almost the same color as the sky.
paintings.setting: Mission Valley in San Diego, named for the Mission San Diego de Alcalá at its eastern end.
paintings.alt: Tall eucalyptus trees on a green grassy slope above a wide valley, with soft blue and lavender hills in the distance.

paintings.file: Guy Rose - Wind swept pines.jpg
paintings.title: Wind Swept Pines
paintings.blurb: This canvas shows one tree, its trunk leaning and its branches spread flat by the wind. It stands on a sandy shore, throwing a shadow on the ground. Behind it the sea is a strong blue, and a far point of land closes the view.
paintings.setting: The shore of the Monterey Peninsula, where wind shapes the trees along the beach.
paintings.alt: A single wind-bent tree with flat spreading branches on a sandy shore, a strong blue sea and a far point of land behind.

paintings.file: Theodore Wores, 1881 - New Year’s Day in San Francisco’s Chinatown.jpg
paintings.title: New Year's Day in San Francisco's Chinatown
paintings.blurb: Wores grew up in San Francisco and painted the people of its Chinatown with care. In this scene two children in bright silk clothes stand with a man by a flower stall, buying plants for the New Year. Balconies and painted shop fronts line the street above them.
paintings.setting: Chinatown in San Francisco during Lunar New Year, when families bought flowering bulbs and branches for good fortune.
paintings.alt: Two children in bright silk clothing stand with a man by a flower stall, balconies and painted shop fronts above.

paintings.file: William Frederic Ritschel.jpg
paintings.title: Seascape, Carmel-by-the-Sea
paintings.blurb: Ritschel painted the surf with thick, fast strokes of blue, green and white. In this canvas waves break over dark rocks and spread across the water in foam. From his house in the Carmel Highlands he could study this kind of sea every day.
paintings.setting: The rocky shore of Carmel-by-the-Sea on the Monterey Peninsula.
paintings.alt: Waves breaking over dark purple rocks, the sea churning with white foam in blue and green.

paintings.file: Edgar Payne Turn in Canyon de Chelly.jpg
paintings.title: Turn in Canyon de Chelly
paintings.blurb: At a bend in the canyon, Payne painted one wall in full sun and the other in shade. The lit cliff is pale gold and cream, the far walls warmer red. Three riders cross the sandy floor at the bottom of the frame.
paintings.setting: Canyon de Chelly in northeastern Arizona, where the canyon walls rise up to a thousand feet.
paintings.alt: Pale gold sunlit cliffs at a bend in a canyon, red walls beyond, and three riders crossing the sandy floor.

paintings.file: Thomas Hill - The Muir Glacier (1888).jpg
paintings.title: The Muir Glacier
paintings.blurb: In this painting the face of the glacier stands across the water in a wall of white and blue ice. Small icebergs float in the green bay, and tiny figures stand on the stony beach. Hill painted it after his trip to Alaska, when the glacier was a stop for tourist steamers.
paintings.setting: Muir Glacier in Glacier Bay, Alaska, which has since retreated many miles up its inlet.
paintings.alt: A tall wall of white and blue glacier ice across a green bay with floating icebergs, tiny figures on a stony beach.

paintings.file: William Keith - Carmel by the Sea.jpg
paintings.title: Carmel by the Sea
paintings.blurb: Keith painted at Carmel around the time the town was founded as a colony for artists and writers. A golden field runs across the front, dark pines stand at the left, and a white beach curves away along the bay. Blue mountains rise on the far side under a light sky.
paintings.setting: Carmel Bay on the Monterey Peninsula, with the Santa Lucia Mountains to the south.
paintings.alt: A golden field with dark pines at left, a white beach curving along a blue bay and mountains on the far side.

paintings.file: Granville Redmond - Rocky Cliffs, Catalina Island.jpg
paintings.title: Rocky Cliffs, Catalina Island
paintings.blurb: Redmond painted Catalina Island many times from his early years on. In this canvas tan and gold cliffs step down to the water in rough blocks. The sea is a strong blue, and the horizon sits high under a pale sky.
paintings.setting: Santa Catalina Island, twenty-two miles off the coast of Los Angeles County.
paintings.alt: Tan and gold rocky cliffs stepping down to a deep blue sea, with a pale sky above a high horizon.

paintings.file: Edgar Payne View at Sabrina Lake, Inyo County.jpg
paintings.title: View at Sabrina Lake, Inyo County
paintings.blurb: Payne painted many lakes on Bishop Creek, west of the town of Bishop. In this canvas jagged peaks in pink and violet rise above a blue lake. A slope of pines, grass and boulders fills the foreground, lit in warm late-day light.
paintings.setting: Lake Sabrina, a reservoir high on Bishop Creek in the eastern Sierra Nevada.
paintings.alt: Jagged pink and violet peaks above a blue lake, with pines, grass and boulders on a sunlit slope in front.

paintings.file: Frank Cuprien - ca74ba7ba4.jpg
paintings.title: Opalescent Evening
paintings.blurb: Cuprien helped found the Laguna Beach Art Association in 1918, and the group's early shows were full of paintings like this one. A set of waves breaks along a sandy beach, the foam running up the sand. The sky and the water share the same pale gold and gray, so the horizon almost disappears.
paintings.setting: A sandy beach at Laguna in the evening, labeled Laguna Beach on the back by the artist.
paintings.alt: Waves breaking in white lines on a sandy beach, the water and sky both pale gold and gray in the evening haze.

paintings.file: William Wendt 'Houses Along the Coast '.png
paintings.title: Houses along the Coast
paintings.blurb: Wendt lived in Laguna Beach from 1918, and he painted the cottages scattered on its hills. In this small canvas a white house with a dark roof sits among green trees on a slope. More trees and a strip of pale sky fill the top.
paintings.setting: The hillsides of Laguna Beach, where cottages stood among trees above the coast.
paintings.alt: A white house with a dark roof among green trees on a slope, more trees and a strip of pale sky above.

paintings.file: Mary DeNeale Morgan Pond's Edge.jpg
paintings.title: Pond's Edge
paintings.blurb: This small gouache is quieter than most of Morgan's coastal work. A pond with reeds lies in the foreground, a fallen log angled into the water. Slim trees stand along the far side, and pale hills rise into a warm evening sky.
paintings.setting: A pond in the countryside near Carmel, where Morgan often worked in gouache on paper.
paintings.alt: A still pond with green reeds and a fallen log, slim trees along the far bank, and pale hills under a warm sky.

paintings.file: Hills at Altadena, by Edgar Alwin Payne.jpg
paintings.title: Hills at Altadena
paintings.blurb: Payne painted this soon after he settled in Southern California. The mountains are pink and rose in the late light, with a pink cloud above them. Dark oaks and a few houses sit in the valley below, and a dirt path crosses the foreground.
paintings.setting: Altadena, on the slopes above Pasadena, below the San Gabriel Mountains.
paintings.alt: Pink and rose mountains under a pale sky with a pink cloud, dark oak trees and a few buildings in the valley below.

paintings.file: Guy Rose, 'Lifting Fog', Irvine Museum.jpg
paintings.title: Lifting Fog
paintings.blurb: Rose was interested in how fog changes the color of the coast. In this canvas the fog is pulling back from a curved beach, leaving the water green and white and the bluffs a warm tan. The far hills are still gray and soft.
paintings.setting: A curved beach on the California coast as the morning fog lifts.
paintings.alt: A curving beach with green water and white surf, tan bluffs above, and gray fog lifting from the hills beyond.

paintings.file: Palm Canyon, by Franz Bischoff.jpg
paintings.title: Palm Canyon
paintings.blurb: Bischoff painted this desert oasis in 1922, on one of his trips to the Palm Springs area. A grove of fan palms with green crowns and shaggy skirts of dead fronds grows among pale boulders. Behind them the canyon walls rise in red and purple, lit by the afternoon sun.
paintings.setting: Palm Canyon, south of Palm Springs on the land of the Agua Caliente Band of Cahuilla Indians, holds one of the largest groves of California fan palms.
paintings.alt: A grove of fan palms among pale boulders in a desert canyon, with red and purple mountains under a blue sky.

paintings.file: Thomas Hill - Vernal Falls, Yosemite.jpg
paintings.title: Vernal Falls, Yosemite
paintings.museum: White House Art Collection, Washington, D.C.
paintings.blurb: This canvas, dated the same year as Hill's view of Nevada Fall, also belongs to the White House. Vernal Fall drops between brown cliffs, with a pale granite dome behind it. Below, the water crashes over boulders in white foam.
paintings.setting: Vernal Fall, on the Merced River in Yosemite, about 317 feet high and reached by the Mist Trail.
paintings.alt: A waterfall dropping between brown cliffs, a pale granite dome behind, and white water crashing over boulders below.

paintings.file: William Keith - Landscape with Mount Shasta.jpg
paintings.title: Landscape with Mount Shasta
paintings.blurb: Mount Shasta, the great volcano of Northern California, was a subject for many western painters. Keith framed it here at the top of a deep, green ravine, with dark trees and rocks on both sides. The peak shows white with snow in a gap of pale sky.
paintings.setting: Mount Shasta in Siskiyou County, a volcano rising over 14,000 feet at the south end of the Cascade Range.
paintings.alt: A deep green ravine with dark trees and rocks on both sides, the white snowy peak of a volcano in the distance.

paintings.file: Land of the Navajo.jpg
paintings.title: Land of the Navajo
paintings.blurb: In many of Payne's Southwest paintings the people are small and the sky is large, as here. A group of Navajo riders crosses a flat green plain. Above them big white clouds fill most of the canvas, and a low mesa runs along the horizon.
paintings.setting: The Navajo Nation, the largest Native American reservation in the United States, spread across Arizona, New Mexico and Utah.
paintings.alt: A group of Navajo riders on horseback crossing a green plain under tall white clouds, a low mesa on the horizon.

paintings.file: Lavender Hills, by Edgar Alwin Payne.jpg
paintings.title: Lavender Hills
paintings.blurb: This is an early California painting, made in Payne's first years in the state. The mountain is lavender and pink, with blue shadows in its canyons. Tall eucalyptus trees stand on a green rise at the right, and a pale valley lies between.
paintings.setting: The San Gabriel Mountains, seen across the valley floor near Pasadena.
paintings.alt: A lavender and pink mountain with blue shadows in its canyons, tall eucalyptus trees on a green rise at right.

paintings.file: Monument Valley, Riverbed.jpg
paintings.title: Monument Valley, Riverbed
paintings.blurb: In this view of Monument Valley the riders follow a dry riverbed lined with green shrubs. Above them rise red sandstone buttes, their faces lit by the sun. White clouds drift in the blue sky behind.
paintings.setting: Monument Valley on the Arizona and Utah border, where washes run between the buttes after rain.
paintings.alt: Three riders following a dry riverbed with green shrubs, red sandstone buttes and white clouds above them.

paintings.file: Mary DeNeale Morgan Springtime Hatton Fields Carmel.jpg
paintings.title: Springtime, Hatton Fields, Carmel
paintings.blurb: Hatton Fields was open ranch land at the edge of Carmel when Morgan painted it. She painted it in spring, with blue lupine running across the meadow and two large oaks on the slope. Green hills roll away behind them under a gray sky.
paintings.setting: Hatton Fields, at the mouth of Carmel Valley, later built over with houses.
paintings.alt: Two large oak trees in a meadow covered with blue lupine, green rolling hills behind them under a gray sky.

paintings.file: Thomas Hill - View in the Sierra Nevadas (1869).jpg
paintings.title: View in the Sierra Nevadas
paintings.blurb: Hill painted this wide, narrow view in 1869, the year the transcontinental railroad opened and made the Sierra easier to reach from the East. A long snowy range runs along the horizon in pale light. In front, a stream runs over rocks past a stand of tall pines and broken stumps.
paintings.setting: The western slope of the Sierra Nevada, looking across forested ridges to the snowy crest.
paintings.alt: A long snowy mountain range on the horizon, with tall pines, rocks and a stream in the shadowed foreground.

paintings.file: William Keith, Sentinel Rock, Yosemite, 2010 116v1.jpg
paintings.title: Sentinel Rock, Yosemite
paintings.museum: Crystal Bridges Museum of American Art, Bentonville, Arkansas
paintings.blurb: In 1872 Keith met John Muir in Yosemite. They became lifelong friends and took many trips into the Sierra together. In this canvas Sentinel Rock rises above the valley floor under a heavy sky, with trees and a small group by the river in front.
paintings.setting: Sentinel Rock, a granite spire on the south side of Yosemite Valley across from Yosemite Falls.
paintings.alt: A tall granite spire rising above a valley under heavy clouds, trees and a small group of people by a river in front.

paintings.file: Laguna Shores – Guy Rose.jpg
paintings.title: Laguna Shores
paintings.blurb: Rose painted this view from a hillside above the beach, with a twisted bare tree at the right. Green shrubs and grass slope down to a pale beach, and blue water curves along the coast toward a distant town. It is one of several views he made of the Laguna coast in 1916.
paintings.setting: The beaches and bluffs of Laguna Beach in Orange County.
paintings.alt: A grassy slope with green shrubs and a bare twisted tree above a pale beach, the blue sea curving along the coastline.

paintings.file: Thomas Hill - Yosemite (1887).jpg
paintings.title: Yosemite
paintings.museum: Blanton Museum of Art, The University of Texas at Austin
paintings.blurb: By 1887 Hill was painting Yosemite for visitors who stopped at his studio in Wawona, and he made many views like this one. El Capitan rises pale and sheer at the left, Bridalveil Fall drops at the right, and the far end of the valley is lost in haze. A few figures stand in the green meadow below.
paintings.setting: The west end of Yosemite Valley, framed by El Capitan and Bridalveil Fall.
paintings.alt: A sheer pale granite cliff at left and a waterfall on the right, a hazy valley between and figures in a green meadow.

paintings.file: Mary DeNeale Morgan Summertime up the River.jpg
paintings.title: Summertime up the River
paintings.blurb: Morgan painted this square canvas in bright, flat color. White sycamore trunks lean over a stretch of turquoise water, and yellow and purple flowers fill the bank in front. More pale trunks stand in a row on the far side, with a purple hill behind.
paintings.setting: The Carmel River upstream from the coast, where sycamores grow along the banks.
paintings.alt: White sycamore trunks leaning over turquoise river water, with yellow and purple flowers on the near bank.

paintings.file: Rose - monterey-cypress.jpg
paintings.title: Monterey Cypress
paintings.blurb: Rose painted the cypress of the Monterey Peninsula during summers there late in the 1910s. Here one tree twists up from a sandy bank, its gray branches reaching out over the water. The sea behind is a deep blue, and white clouds cross the sky.
paintings.setting: The Monterey Peninsula, where the Monterey cypress grows naturally.
paintings.alt: A twisting cypress tree with gray branches on a sandy bank, a deep blue sea and white clouds behind.

paintings.file: William Ritschel - Coral reefs.jpg
paintings.title: Coral Reefs
paintings.blurb: This painting came to Wikimedia Commons under the title Coral Reefs, though it shows a rocky shore. Dark rocks stand in a turquoise sea, and waves break over them in white spray. Ritschel kept the horizon high, so the water fills most of the canvas.
paintings.setting: A rocky coast in strong surf, the subject Ritschel painted most.
paintings.alt: Dark rocks in a turquoise sea with waves breaking over them in white spray, a high horizon at the top.

paintings.file: Frank Cuprien - ea0416e863.jpg
paintings.title: Laguna Beach, California
paintings.blurb: Cuprien painted this late in his life, after three decades on the same stretch of coast. The setting sun lays a band of gold on the water, and waves catch the light as they come in. Far out, a few sailboats sit on the horizon. He signed the canvas in the corner and wrote the place and year on the back.
paintings.setting: Sunset over the Pacific at Laguna Beach, where Cuprien lived and worked until his death in 1948.
paintings.alt: A golden sunset over the ocean, the sun's reflection a bright band on the water, waves near the shore and tiny sailboats far out.

paintings.file: WLA lacma California Landscape by William Wendt.jpg
paintings.title: California Landscape
paintings.museum: Los Angeles County Museum of Art
paintings.blurb: This photograph shows the painting in its frame at the Los Angeles County Museum of Art. The canvas is almost six feet wide. Wendt laid out rolling hills in green, gold and rust, dotted with trees, under a range of dark mountains and white clouds.
paintings.setting: The rolling hills of Southern California, which Wendt painted on a large scale.
paintings.alt: A wide painting in a frame showing rolling green and gold hills dotted with trees, dark mountains and white clouds behind.

paintings.file: Navajo Country.jpg
paintings.title: Navajo Country
paintings.blurb: Payne set the horizon very low here and filled the canvas with clouds in white, gray and lavender. A line of riders crosses the plain at the bottom, with red mesas behind them. The land takes up less than a fifth of the picture.
paintings.setting: The broad plains and mesas of the Navajo Nation in Arizona.
paintings.alt: Tall white and lavender clouds filling a blue sky, a line of small riders crossing a plain below red mesas.

paintings.file: The Arroyo Seco, Pasadena.jpg
paintings.title: The Arroyo Seco, Pasadena
paintings.blurb: This photograph of the painting shows it in its gilded frame on the wall of the Crocker Art Museum. Bischoff looked across the open land of the Arroyo Seco when much of it was still grassland and oak. Golden hills roll toward a line of blue mountains, with dark oaks set along the slopes.
paintings.setting: The Arroyo Seco near Bischoff's South Pasadena home, before the canyon was built up.
paintings.alt: A painting in an ornate gold frame showing golden rolling hills dotted with dark oaks and blue mountains in the distance.

paintings.file: Thomas hill the golden gate from point lobos 094017).jpg
paintings.title: The Golden Gate from Point Lobos
paintings.blurb: This Point Lobos is the rocky headland at the west end of San Francisco, not the one near Carmel. Hill painted dark rocks scattered on a beach, with waves breaking around them and a red cliff at the right. Across the water the hills of the far shore sit under pink clouds.
paintings.setting: Point Lobos in San Francisco, near Lands End, looking toward the entrance to San Francisco Bay.
paintings.alt: Dark rocks on a sandy beach with breaking waves, a red cliff at right and hills across the water under pink clouds.

paintings.file: Yosemite Valley LACMA M.71.115 (1 of 2).jpg
paintings.title: Yosemite Valley
paintings.museum: Los Angeles County Museum of Art
paintings.blurb: In this view the Merced River runs flat and still across the front, with a fallen log in the water and riders on the far bank. Pines line the shore, and the granite cliffs behind are pale pink in hazy light. Keith painted it in 1875, in the years he was walking the Sierra with Muir.
paintings.setting: The Merced River on the floor of Yosemite Valley.
paintings.alt: A still river with a fallen log and riders on the far bank, pines along the shore and pale pink cliffs in the haze.

paintings.file: Payne Lake by Edgar Alwin Payne.jpg
paintings.title: Payne Lake
paintings.blurb: This lake in the Sierra carries the painter's name, and Payne painted it more than once. Blue and violet peaks with snowfields rise behind a lake of deep turquoise. A few twisted pines stand on the near shore, with a strip of green grass at the right.
paintings.setting: Payne Lake, a lake in the high Sierra Nevada named for the painter, who camped and painted in the range for decades.
paintings.alt: Blue and violet mountain peaks with white snowfields above a turquoise lake, a few twisted pines on the near shore.

paintings.file: Jack Wilkinson Smith - e3f477a818.jpg
paintings.title: Waterfall Along a River
paintings.blurb: Granite and moving water were two of Smith's favorite subjects, and he joined them here. A short waterfall drops between large, rounded boulders into a dark pool, and the current runs off toward the viewer. A forest of firs and pines rises behind the rocks.
paintings.setting: A river in the Sierra Nevada, where snowmelt runs fast between granite boulders.
paintings.alt: A short white waterfall pouring between large rounded boulders into a dark pool, with tall forest trees behind.

paintings.file: Granville Redmond Malibu Coast Spring.jpg
paintings.title: Malibu Coast, Spring
paintings.blurb: Redmond painted this late in his career, when much of the Malibu coast was still ranch land. Green hills covered with orange poppies and blue lupine roll down toward the sea. The coastline curves away to a far point under white clouds.
paintings.setting: The Malibu coast in Los Angeles County, west of Santa Monica.
paintings.alt: Green hills with orange poppies and blue lupine rolling toward the ocean, the coastline curving away under white clouds.

paintings.file: The Lone Packer.jpg
paintings.title: The Lone Packer
paintings.blurb: A single rider in a broad hat sits his horse on a slope of tan rock, a pack animal behind him. He looks out over a deep valley to a range of blue-gray peaks. Payne painted the rocks in front with broad, flat strokes of warm color against the cool distance.
paintings.setting: A high trail in the Sierra Nevada, above a glacier-cut valley.
paintings.alt: A lone rider in a wide hat on a horse on a tan rocky slope, looking out over a valley toward blue-gray peaks.

paintings.file: Mary DeNeale Morgan The F.A. Wickett Home.jpg
paintings.title: The F.A. Wickett Home
paintings.blurb: The title names this house for its owner, and Morgan painted it as a portrait of the place. A stucco house with an arched doorway sits behind trimmed hedges and flowering shrubs. Large spreading trees arch over the roof, and a patch of blue sky shows through the branches.
paintings.setting: A private home on the Monterey Peninsula, painted when Morgan had lived in Carmel for more than twenty years.
paintings.alt: A stucco house with an arched doorway behind green hedges and flowers, large spreading trees arching over the roof.

paintings.file: The Pack Train, Sierra Grande by Edgar Alwin Payne.jpg
paintings.title: The Pack Train, Sierra Grande
paintings.blurb: This large canvas, more than three feet wide, shows a pack train coming through a high valley. Riders and loaded animals move through sage and boulders at the lower right. Behind them a forest of pines climbs toward bare granite peaks streaked with snow.
paintings.setting: A wide valley high in the Sierra Nevada, with forest giving way to bare granite above.
paintings.alt: A pack train of riders and loaded animals moving through sage and boulders, pines and snow-streaked granite peaks behind.

paintings.file: Yosemite, Sentinel Rock by William Keith, 1872.jpg
paintings.title: Yosemite, Sentinel Rock
paintings.blurb: Keith painted Sentinel Rock more than once in 1872. This tall version puts the spire high in the frame, half in cloud. Autumn trees in yellow and green line a still pool below, where a small figure stands at the edge.
paintings.setting: Sentinel Rock in Yosemite Valley, which rises about 3,000 feet above the valley floor.
paintings.alt: A tall granite spire half in cloud above autumn trees and a still pool, a small figure standing at the water's edge.

paintings.file: Twin Peaks by Edgar Payne.jpg
paintings.title: Twin Peaks
paintings.blurb: Payne painted this large canvas with two dark peaks side by side above a lake. Snow fills the gullies and a long talus slope runs down to the water. White clouds sit on the ridge in a blue sky, and a few dark pines stand at the right edge.
paintings.setting: A lake basin below twin summits in the high Sierra Nevada.
paintings.alt: Two dark mountain peaks with snow in their gullies above a long talus slope and a dark lake, white clouds above.
